e.title: **一份**把**「**法定**赔付**上限」**当**成**分布**截断**点**、**并**把**「**限额**指数化」**单**列**为**一**类**风险**的**强制**车险**聚合**损失**复现**包****：`colombia-peru-motorcycle-lda`——**⭐ 逐字标题**为**「**Replication package for the article "Statutory Cap Indexation and Operational Risk in Compulsory Motor Insurance: Aggregate Losses from Motorcycle Claims in Colombia and Peru, 2025-2026"**」**；**⭐ 方法**逐字**：**严重**度**用**在**法定**上限**处**右**截断**的**对数**正态****（**逐字**：**lognormal right-truncated at the legal cap of the cover, not as a free lognormal, because the insurer does not pay above that cap**）**；**⭐ 并**逐字**把**64 个**官方**数字**逐行**登记**（**发布**机构、**URL、**查阅**日期**与**来源**分歧**备注）**，**且**逐字**声明**「**No figure in this work comes from a private sample, from an estimate by the authors, or from an undeclared assumption.**」**
e.summary: **Statutory Cap Indexation and Operational Risk in Compulsory Motor Insurance**（Zenodo `10.5281/zenodo.22834349`）**是一份**把**「**法定赔付上限」**当**成**分布截断点**、**并**把**「**限额指数化」**单列**为**一**类**风险的**强制车险**聚合损失**复现包****——**逐字标题**为**「**Replication package for the article "Statutory Cap Indexation and Operational Risk in Compulsory Motor Insurance: Aggregate Losses from Motorcycle Claims in Colombia and Peru, 2025-2026"**」**。**本次实测**：**⭐ 发布日 **2026-09-18****（**窗口内）**、**类型逐字 **`software`****、**许可逐字 **`cc-by-4.0`****、**作者逐字 **`Restrepo-Morales, Jorge A.`****、**文件**逐字**为 **`23_LDAAccidentesMoto_replication.zip`（**274,619 B）**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**跨仓储聚合面**」**，**并**补上**本站**最薄的一栏之一**——**学术研究**（**实测**本轮**之前 **27** 条）**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **它**把**「**保额**上限」**直接**做**成**分布**的**截断**点****——**⭐ 逐字**「**Severity is modelled as a lognormal right-truncated at the legal cap of the cover, not as a free lognormal, because the insurer does not pay above that cap.**」**——**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**是**本条**最**可**迁移**的**技术**点**：**⭐ 即**强制**险**的**赔付**被**法定**限额**切**断**，**若**用**自由**对数**正态**拟合**，**尾部**会**被**虚拟**地**拉**长**，**从**而**高**估**巨灾**与**再保**层**的**成本**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**遇**到**有**法定**或**合同**上限**的**险种**（**强制**车险、**社保**封**顶、**再保**层）**，**先**问**「**分布**在**哪**里**被**截**断」**；**② **它**把**「**限额**指数化」**单列**为**一**类**风险**并**做**分解****——**⭐ 逐字**「**the indexation of the cover is treated as a source of risk separate from claim frequency and severity, so that its contribution to the change in Value at Risk between 2025 and 2026 can be decomposed**」**——**⭐ 即**「**上限**本身**涨**了」**与**「**赔付**变**多**了」**被**分**开**计**量**；**③ **它**把 **64 个**官方**数字**逐行**登记**并**说明**脚本**按**标识符**读**取****（**逐字**：**with the publishing body, the URL, the date of consultation and a note recording any discrepancy between sources. The scripts read this file by identifier, so correcting a figure there updates the whole pipeline.**）**，**且**逐字**声明**没有**任何**数字**来自**私人**样本**、**作者**估计**或**未**声明**假设**；**④ **它**把**数据**的**极限**逐条**写**在**包里****（**⭐ 逐字**：**个体**理赔**登记**在**两**国**都**不**公开**，**故**校准**只**用**监管**机构**公布**的**汇总**数**（**与**定**费率**所**用**输入**相同）**；**对数**正态**的**函数**形式**无法**与**替代**形式**做**检验**；**识别**是**恰好**识别**（**两**个**矩**条件**对**两**个**参数）**而**不**是**过度**识别**；**过度**离散**指数**不**做**估计**，**改**在 **1.10／**1.25／**1.50／**1.75／**2.00** 的**网格**上**声明**并**报告** VaR 的**敏感性**，**中心**情形 **1.50**）**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**「**哪些**参数**我**估**不**了、**我**就**声**明**它**并**做**网格**敏感**性」**是**一**种**可**直接**照**抄**的**诚实**写法**。**⚠️ 本次**未下载**其 **zip**、**未**重跑**其**蒙特**卡洛**。
e.body:
**Statutory Cap Indexation and Operational Risk in Compulsory Motor Insurance**（Zenodo `10.5281/zenodo.22834349`）**是一份**把**「**法定赔付上限」**当**成**分布截断点**、**并**把**「**限额指数化」**单列**为**一**类**风险的**强制车险**聚合损失**复现包****——**逐字标题**为**「**Replication package for the article "Statutory Cap Indexation and Operational Risk in Compulsory Motor Insurance: Aggregate Losses from Motorcycle Claims in Colombia and Peru, 2025-2026"**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**跨仓储聚合面**」**。
**可核实信息（均 2026-09-22 Zenodo 记录接口实测）**：
**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它**把**「**保额**上限」**直接**做**成**分布**的**截断**点**，**而**不**是**自由**分布****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**描述**逐字**写**「**Severity is modelled as a lognormal right-truncated at the legal cap of the cover, not as a free lognormal, because the insurer does not pay above that cap.**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**对 **RIAA** 最**有**用**：**⭐ 即**强制**车险**（**哥伦比亚 **SOAT／**秘鲁）**的**赔付**被**法定**限额**切**断**，**若**用**自由**对数**正态**拟合**，**模型**会**在**上限**之外**继续**放**出**损失**，**从**而**把**巨灾**层**与**再保**层**的**成本**高**估**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**凡是**有**法定**或**合同**上限**的**险种**（**强制**险、**社保**封**顶**、**再保**层**结构**、**超额**赔款**），**建模**前**先**问**「**分布**在**哪**里**被**截**断」**；**⭐ 而**这**一**点**在**教科书**的**聚合**损失**模型**（**LDA）**里**常**被**忽**略**（**默认**用**自由**分布）**。
**⭐⭐ ② 它**把**「**限额**指数化」**单列**为**一**类**风险**并**做**分解**，**而**不**混**进**频**率**与**严重**度****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**描述**逐字**写**「**the indexation of the cover is treated as a source of risk separate from claim frequency and severity, so that its contribution to the change in Value at Risk between 2025 and 2026 can be decomposed**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为**：**⭐ 即**「**上限**本身**涨**了」**（**政策**变量）**与**「**事故**变**多**或**变**重」**（**风险**变量）**在**总**损失**变化**里**各**占**多少**，**被**分**开**报**告**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**做**赔付**成本**变化**的**归因**分析**时**，**把**「**规则**变化」**与**「**风险**变化」**分**列**，**是**一**个**可**照**抄**的**分解**框架**。
**⭐⭐ ③ 它**把 **64 个**官方**数字**逐行**登记**，**并**让**脚本**按**标识符**读**取****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**描述**逐字**写**「**data/raw/fuentes_oficiales_2026.csv - the 64 official figures on which every result rests, one row each, with the publishing body, the URL, the date of consultation and a note recording any discrepancy between sources. The scripts read this file by identifier, so correcting a figure there updates the whole pipeline.**」**，**并**逐字**声明**「**No figure in this work comes from a private sample, from an estimate by the authors, or from an undeclared assumption.**」**；**⭐ 本词条**据此**指出**：**⭐ 即**「**一个**数字**一**行**、**带**发布**机构**与**查阅**日期**、**并**记录**来源**之间**的**分歧」**是**一**种**可**迁移**的**数据**登记**方式**（**⭐ 与**第 **378** 轮**「**样本**与**全量**要**标注」**、**第 **379** 轮**「**起点／**边界／**排除**项**要**写**清」**同**属**来源**治理**一**脉）**；**⭐ 而**「**按**标识符**读**取」**意味**着**改**一**处**、**全**管线**跟着**更**新**，**避**免**了**硬**编码**散**落**。
**⭐⭐ ④ 它**把**数据**的**极限**逐条**写**在**包**里**，**并**对**估**不**了**的**参数**做**网格**敏感**性****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**描述**逐字**写**「**The individual claims register of compulsory motor insurance is not public in either country. Calibration therefore uses the aggregates that the regulators publish, which are the same inputs used to set the tariff. Two consequences follow. The lognormal functional form cannot be tested against alternatives, because there is no sample on which to examine residuals. Identification is exact, two moment conditions for two parameters, not overidentified. The frequency overdispersion index is not estimated. It is declared over a grid of 1.10, 1.25, 1.50, 1.75 and 2.00, and the sensitivity of Value at Risk along that grid is reported. The central case is 1.50.**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**是**本条**最**值得**学**的**写法**：**⭐ 即**四**条**极限**各**有**明**确**的**应**对**——**数据**不**公开**→**用**监管**汇总**并**说明**它**与**定**费率**同源**；**形式**不**可**检验**→**明**说**没**有**残**差**样本**；**识别**恰好**→**明**说**不**是**过度**识别**；**参数**估**不**了**→**在**网格**上**声明**并**报告**敏感**性**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**「**估**不**了**就**声**明**＋**做**敏感**性」**比**「**假**装**估**出**来**」**有**说服**力**得**多**。
**⭐⭐ ⑤ 复现**细节**与**自检**规**模**都**写**明****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**描述**逐字**给出**运行**顺序**（**`01_calibrar_parametros.py` → **`02_lda_montecarlo.py`）**、**环境**要求**（**Python 3.11+** 与 **numpy／**pandas／**scipy／**matplotlib）**、**计算**量**（**逐字**：**the Colombian scenario requires about 70 million severity draws per run and roughly forty runs are performed**）**、**随机**种子**（**逐字**：**Seeds are fixed, 20260907 in the simulation and 42 in the severity moment calculation, so results reproduce bit for bit with the same versions of numpy and scipy**）**，**与**一**个**独**立**校验**脚本**（**逐字**：**The verification script contrasts 40 figures per version against the files the pipeline produces, and all 80 checks must pass before the package is considered closed.**）**；**⭐ 本词条**据此**指出**：**⭐ 即**「**80** 个**检查**全**过**才**算**交付」**这**条**门**槛**，**把**「**可**复现」**从**口号**变**成**可**执行**的**条**件**（**⭐ 与**第 **379** 轮 **VaR** 审计**的 **`--check`** 同**一**做法）**。
**⭐⭐ ⑥ 元数据**、**许可**与**窗口****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**发布日 **2026-09-18****（**窗口内）**、**类型逐字 **`software`****、**许可逐字 **`cc-by-4.0`****（**描述**末尾**亦**逐字**写 **`Licence Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0).`）**、**作者逐字 **`Restrepo-Morales, Jorge A.`****、**文件**逐字 **`23_LDAAccidentesMoto_replication.zip`（**274,619 B）**；**⭐ 本词条**如实**指出**：**⭐ 即**它**的**来源**清单**逐字**列**出 **17 个**官方**机构**（**Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia、**Fasecolda、**ADRES、**ANSV、**RUNT、**DANE、**Ministerio de Hacienda、**Ministerio de Salud y Proteccion Social、**SBS、**APESEG、**ONSV、**PNP、**MTC、**MEF、**INEI** 与 **SUNARP）**，**但**本词条**未**逐**个**打开**核**对**。
**⭐⭐ ⑦ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[motor-pricing-glm]]、**[[motor-pricing-evt-xl]] 与 **[[insurance-evt]] 覆盖**车险**定价**与**极值**方法**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**把**法定**上限**当**截断**点、**并**把**限额**指数化**单列**为**风险**的**强制**车险**复现**包**」这一**形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。
**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **有**上限**的**险种**要**先**问**截断**点**；**② **把**「**规则**变化」**与**「**风险**变化」**在**归因**里**分**列**；**③ **官方**数字**逐行**登记**（**机构、**URL、**日期、**分歧**备注）**并**按**标识符**读**取**；**④ **估**不**了**的**参数**要**声明**并**做**网格**敏感**性**；**⑤ **给**交付**设**一**个**「**检查**全**过**才**算**完成」**的门**槛**。
**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有下载**其 **zip**（**274,619 B）**、**未**运行**其**任何**脚本**、**未**重跑**其**蒙特**卡洛**，**故**不**主张**其**可**复现**性**、**数值**正确性**或**结果**稳健**性**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**Zenodo** 记录**接口**返回的**元数据与描述**（**描述**实测 **4,066** 字符）**，**未读**其**代码**、**数据**文件**或**论文**（**西班牙**语**与**英语**两**版）**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其 **17 个**官方**来源**是否**逐**个**可**访问**（**只**按**描述**记录**其**清单）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其 **64** 个**官方**数字**与 **80** 个**校验**的**实际**数量**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其**关于**「**哥伦比亚**方案**自 **2026** 起**用**三**种**不同**记账**单位」**的**核心**发现**（**只**按**其**自述**记录）**。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核实**其**是否**已**发表**或**正**在**评审**（**⭐ 与**第 **379** 轮**的**沙特**审稿**回应**包**不同，**本条**的**描述**未**提**评审**状态）**。**⑦ ⚠️ 窗口**状况**：**发布日 **2026-09-18** 落在**本轮**窗口**之内**（**基准日 **2026-09-22）**，**故**无需**缺口**说明**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-22 所见**；**⚠️ 涉及**强制**车险**与**赔付**上限**，**⚠️ 不**构成**任何**定价**、**核保**或**法律**意见**。

e.title_en: A replication package for an article on compulsory motor insurance that treats the statutory cap as a truncation point and indexation of the cover as a separate risk source: it models severity as a lognormal right-truncated at the legal cap rather than as a free lognormal, on the stated grounds that the insurer does not pay above that cap, and it registers each of sixty-four official figures in one row each with the publishing body, the URL, the date of consultation, and a note recording discrepancies between sources, while stating in writing that no figure comes from a private sample, from an estimate by the authors, or from an undeclared assumption.
e.title_hk: **一份**把**「**法定賠付上限」**當成**分布**截斷**點**、**並把**「**限額指數化」**單列**為一類風險的**強制車險聚合損失復現包****：`colombia-peru-motorcycle-lda`——**⭐ 逐字標題為**「**Replication package for the article "Statutory Cap Indexation and Operational Risk in Compulsory Motor Insurance: Aggregate Losses from Motorcycle Claims in Colombia and Peru, 2025-2026"**」**；**⭐ 方法逐字**：**嚴重度用在**法定上限處右截斷的對數正態****（**逐字**lognormal right-truncated at the legal cap of the cover, not as a free lognormal, because the insurer does not pay above that cap**）**；**⭐ 並逐字把 64 個官方數字逐行登記**（**發布機構、**URL、**查閱日期與**來源分歧備註）**，**且逐字聲明**「**No figure in this work comes from a private sample, from an estimate by the authors, or from an undeclared assumption.**」**
e.summary_en: This is a replication package for an article on compulsory motor insurance that treats the statutory cap as a truncation point and the indexation of the cover as a separate risk source. **Measured this round**: published on the eighteenth of September inside the window, typed as software, licensed for attribution use, credited to one author, and shipped as a single archive of about a quarter of a megabyte. **This entry belongs to the round theme of cross-repository metadata aggregation and fills one of the thinnest categories on the site, academic research, which held twenty-seven entries before this round.** **Four things are worth reading: it treats the cap as a distributional truncation point, modelling severity as a lognormal right-truncated at the legal cap rather than as a free lognormal because the insurer does not pay above that cap, which is the most transferable technical point here, since a free lognormal would stretch the tail and overstate the cost of catastrophe and reinsurance layers in any line with a statutory or contractual cap, so the first question for such lines is where the distribution is truncated; it treats the indexation of the cover as a risk source separate from claim frequency and severity, so the contribution of a rising cap to the change in value at risk between two years can be decomposed, keeping the cap moving distinct from claims getting worse; it registers each of sixty-four official figures in one row each with the publishing body, the URL, the consultation date, and a note recording discrepancies between sources, has scripts read that file by identifier so correcting a figure updates the whole pipeline, and states in writing that no figure comes from a private sample, from an estimate by the authors, or from an undeclared assumption; and it writes the limits of the data into the package itself, namely that individual claims registers are not public in either country so calibration uses the regulator aggregates that are the same inputs used to set the tariff, that the functional form cannot be tested against alternatives for lack of a sample for residuals, that identification is exact rather than overidentified, and that the overdispersion index is not estimated but declared over a grid with the central case at one and a half and the sensitivity of value at risk reported along it, which is a directly copyable way of being honest about a parameter that cannot be estimated.** **No archive was downloaded and the Monte Carlo study was not rerun this round.**

e.body_en:
This is a replication package for an article on statutory cap indexation and operational risk in compulsory motor insurance, covering aggregate losses from motorcycle claims in two countries. **This entry belongs to the round theme of cross-repository metadata aggregation.**
**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-22 from the record interface**:
**First, it treats the cap as a distributional truncation point rather than leaving the distribution free.** The description states that severity is modelled as a lognormal right-truncated at the legal cap of the cover rather than as a free lognormal, because the insurer does not pay above that cap. **Compulsory motor insurance pays only up to a statutory limit, so a free lognormal keeps emitting losses beyond that limit and overstates the cost of catastrophe layers and reinsurance layers. For any line with a statutory or contractual cap, including compulsory covers, social security ceilings, reinsurance layer structures, and excess of loss treaties, the first modelling question is where the distribution is truncated, a point classical aggregate loss modelling tends to skip by defaulting to a free distribution.**
**Second, it separates the indexation of the cover from claim frequency and severity as its own risk source.** The description states that indexation is treated as a source of risk separate from frequency and severity, so that its contribution to the change in value at risk between two years can be decomposed. **Whether the cap itself rose, a policy variable, and whether claims became more frequent or more severe, a risk variable, are therefore reported separately, which is a directly transferable attribution framework for analysing changes in claims cost.**
**Third, it registers each official figure in one row and has scripts read the file by identifier.** The raw data file holds sixty-four official figures on which every result rests, one row each, with the publishing body, the URL, the consultation date, and a note recording discrepancies between sources, and the scripts read this file by identifier, so correcting a figure updates the whole pipeline. The description also states that no figure comes from a private sample, from an estimate by the authors, or from an undeclared assumption. **One figure per row with a publisher, a date, and a recorded discrepancy is a durable way to keep provenance, and reading by identifier keeps hard-coded values from scattering across scripts.**
**Fourth, it writes the limits of the data into the package and handles an unestimable parameter with a grid.** The description states that the individual claims register is not public in either country, so calibration uses regulator aggregates that are the same inputs used to set the tariff; that the functional form cannot be tested against alternatives because there is no sample on which to examine residuals; that identification is exact, two moment conditions for two parameters, rather than overidentified; and that the overdispersion index is not estimated but declared over a grid from one point one to two point zero with a central case at one and a half and the sensitivity of value at risk reported along it. **Declaring a parameter as unestimated and reporting sensitivity over a grid is far more persuasive than pretending to have estimated it.**
**Fifth, reproduction details and self-check scale are stated.** The description gives the run order, the environment requirements, the computational scale, namely about seventy million severity draws per run and roughly forty runs for one country scenario, and fixed seeds for the simulation and for the severity moment calculation so results reproduce exactly with the same library versions. **A verification script contrasts forty figures per language version against the pipeline outputs and all eighty checks must pass before the package is considered closed, which turns reproducibility from a slogan into an executable condition, in the same spirit as the check script recorded in an earlier round.**
**Sixth, metadata, licence, and window status.** Published on the eighteenth of September inside the window, typed as software, licensed for attribution use as the description also states verbatim, credited to one author, and shipped as an archive of about a quarter of a megabyte. **Its source list names seventeen official bodies across the two countries, though this entry did not open each one.**
**Seventh, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover motor pricing with generalised linear models, extreme value motor pricing, and extreme value tooling, **while this entry supplies the form of a compulsory motor insurance replication package that truncates at the statutory cap and separates cap indexation as a risk source. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**
**For RIAA**: **five practices transfer: ask where a capped line is truncated; separate rule changes from risk changes in attribution; register official figures one per row with publisher, date, and discrepancy notes, and read them by identifier; declare unestimable parameters and report grid sensitivity; and give delivery a check-all-must-pass gate.**
**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no archive was downloaded, no script was run, and the Monte Carlo study was not rerun**, so no claim is made about reproducibility, numerical correctness, or robustness. **Second, only metadata and description, measured at about four thousand characters, were read**, not the code, the data files, or either language version of the manuscript. **Third, whether the seventeen named official sources are individually reachable was not verified**, this entry recording only the list. **Fourth, the stated counts of figures and checks were not verified. Fifth, the central finding about three different units of account in one national scheme was not verified**, this entry recording only what the package states. **Sixth, whether the article has been published or is under review was not verified**, the description being silent on review status. **Seventh, the publication date falls inside this round window against a baseline of the twenty-second of September. Eighth, this entry records what was visible on that date and states plainly that it constitutes no pricing, underwriting, or legal opinion.**
e.body_hk:
**Statutory Cap Indexation and Operational Risk in Compulsory Motor Insurance**（Zenodo `10.5281/zenodo.22834349`）**是一份**把**「**法定賠付上限」**當成**分布**截斷**點**、**並把**「**限額指數化」**單列**為一類風險的**強制車險聚合損失復現包****——**逐字標題**為**「**Replication package for the article "Statutory Cap Indexation and Operational Risk in Compulsory Motor Insurance: Aggregate Losses from Motorcycle Claims in Colombia and Peru, 2025-2026"**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**跨倉儲聚合面**」**。
**可核實資訊（均 2026-09-22 Zenodo 記錄介面實測）**：
**⭐⭐⭐ ① 把保額上限直接做成分布的截斷點**——**逐字**Severity is modelled as a lognormal right-truncated at the legal cap of the cover, not as a free lognormal, because the insurer does not pay above that cap.**；**⭐ 即**用自由對數正態會在上限之外繼續放出損失**，**從而高估巨災層與再保層成本**；**⭐ 對 RIAA**：**凡有法定或合同上限的險種，建模前先問分布在哪裡被截斷**。
**⭐⭐ ② 把限額指數化單列為一類風險並做分解**——**逐字**the indexation of the cover is treated as a source of risk separate from claim frequency and severity, so that its contribution to the change in Value at Risk between 2025 and 2026 can be decomposed**；**⭐ 即**規則變化與風險變化在歸因裡分列**。
**⭐⭐ ③ 官方數字逐行登記並按標識符讀取**——**逐字**data/raw/fuentes_oficiales_2026.csv - the 64 official figures on which every result rests, one row each, with the publishing body, the URL, the date of consultation and a note recording any discrepancy between sources. The scripts read this file by identifier, so correcting a figure there updates the whole pipeline.** 與 **No figure in this work comes from a private sample, from an estimate by the authors, or from an undeclared assumption.**。
**⭐⭐ ④ 把數據的極限逐條寫在包裡並對估不了的參數做網格敏感性**——**逐字**The individual claims register of compulsory motor insurance is not public in either country. Calibration therefore uses the aggregates that the regulators publish, which are the same inputs used to set the tariff. Two consequences follow. The lognormal functional form cannot be tested against alternatives, because there is no sample on which to examine residuals. Identification is exact, two moment conditions for two parameters, not overidentified. The frequency overdispersion index is not estimated. It is declared over a grid of 1.10, 1.25, 1.50, 1.75 and 2.00, and the sensitivity of Value at Risk along that grid is reported. The central case is 1.50.**；**⭐ 即**估不了就聲明＋做敏感性**。
**⭐⭐ ⑤ 復現細節與自檢規模都寫明**——**逐字**the Colombian scenario requires about 70 million severity draws per run and roughly forty runs are performed** 與 **Seeds are fixed, 20260907 in the simulation and 42 in the severity moment calculation** 與 **The verification script contrasts 40 figures per version against the files the pipeline produces, and all 80 checks must pass before the package is considered closed.**；**⭐ 即**80 個檢查全過才算交付**。
**⭐⭐ ⑥ 元數據、**許可與**窗口**——**發布日 2026-09-18**、**類型 `software`**、**許可 `cc-by-4.0`**、**作者 `Restrepo-Morales, Jorge A.`**、**文件 274,619 B**；**來源清單逐字列 17 個官方機構**（**含 Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia、**Fasecolda、**DANE、**SBS、**APESEG、**INEI、**SUNARP 等）**，**本條未逐個打開核對**。
**⭐⭐ ⑦ 與池內條目的關係**：[[motor-pricing-glm]]、[[motor-pricing-evt-xl]]、[[insurance-evt]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**把法定上限當截斷點、**並把限額指數化單列為風險的強制車險復現包**」**這一形態**。
**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **先問截斷點**；**② **規則變化與風險變化分列**；**③ **官方數字逐行登記並按標識符讀取**；**④ **估不了的參數聲明＋網格敏感性**；**⑤ **給交付設檢查門檻**。
**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有下載其 zip、**未運行任何腳本、**未重跑蒙特卡洛**，**不主張其可復現性、**數值正確性或**結果穩健性**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀 Zenodo 記錄介面返回的元資料與描述（**實測 4,066 字符）**，**未讀其代碼、**數據文件或**論文兩版**。**③ ⚠️ **未核實**其 17 個官方來源是否逐個可訪問**。**④ ⚠️ **未核實**其 64 個數字與 80 個校驗的實際數量**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核實**其關於哥倫比亞方案自 2026 起用三種記賬單位的核心發現**。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核實**其是否已發表或正在評審**。**⑦ ⚠️ 窗口狀況：**發布日 2026-09-18 在本輪窗口之內（**基準日 2026-09-22）**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-22 所見**；**⚠️ 不構成任何定價、**核保或**法律意見**。
